title: Etablissement français du sang Refrigerators Hit by Cyberattack
detail: Refrigerators operated by the Etablissement français du sang (French blood service) have been hit by a cyberattack, Le Monde reports.

title: France's 2026 Public Deficit Overshoot Made Official
detail: The slippage of France's 2026 public deficit beyond target has been officially confirmed, according to Le Monde.

title: CFDT and CGT Denounce Conditions Set for Nov 5 Strike Demonstrations
detail: The CFDT and CGT unions denounced the conditions set for organising the demonstrations planned for the November 5 strike, Le Monde reports.
